Pranav Shukla

Robotics Engineer & AI Researcher specializing in Embodied AI, Reinforcement Learning, and Mechatronics.

I focus on bridging the gap between advanced artificial intelligence and physical robotic execution. My recent work at the GRAIL Lab (NYU Courant) and FAMS NYU involves developing cutting-edge frameworks for Embodied AI, multi-robot coordination, and sim-to-real reinforcement learning. My expertise lies in zero-code LLM/VLM-driven control systems, bimanual teleoperation, robust optimal control (MPC/SQP), and designing custom hardware solutions like stabilized 3D LiDARs and multi-axis mobile manipulators.
